dependencies: SHARES SAVE-STATE WITH DARK SUN GWYNDOLIN'S DISGUISE FORM — this is not a separate character. Never let a tool independently "revive Gwynevere" and "kill Gwyndolin's disguise" as two different operations; always change both entries together (see Dark Sun Gwyndolin entry).
Darkmoon Knightess's aggro reads this NPC's own death flag as part of an OR — see her entry.

FULL REVIVAL REQUIRES ALL 5 POSITIONS ABOVE TOGETHER — live-tested and confirmed 2026-11-09 (character N0, slot 9), both directions (revive AND kill via save edit, matching a genuine in-game kill/revive exactly). Clearing/setting only a subset (e.g. just 0xF1, or just 0xF1+0xF2, or the 3 extra bits without 0xF2) was live-tested and FAILS — either an infinite one-phrase dialogue loop (native CheckSelfDeath() still true) or a replayed illusion-reveal cutscene with no actual fix. See project memory project_ds1_gwynevere_talk_bug.md and project_ds1_npc_revival_methodology.md for the full bisection trace.
